headline_seed: Hayden Panettiere, actor known for "Heroes" and "Remember the Titans," dies at 36 - CBS News
draft_text:
Hayden Panettiere, who played Claire Bennet in Heroes and earned two Golden Globe nominations for Nashville, died Sunday in Greenville, S.C. She was 36. AP and ABC News confirm cardiac arrest; no cause yet determined.

And that's the mews.
